input.answer: Canada's job vacancy rate was 2.9% in August 2026 (unadjusted for seasonality, all industries). That means about 2.9 of every 100 jobs (payroll employees plus vacant positions) were unfilled. For comparison, the rate was 2.8% in July 2026. I used the unadjusted monthly table because the question didn't specify seasonal adjustment.
